shortDescription: Reserve a free TCP port and persist the mapping in a registry file.

options.name: hash
options.description: Stable identifier used as the key in the registry. Often a process ID or deployment ID.

options.name: max_port
options.description: Upper bound of the allowed port range (inclusive).

options.name: min_port
options.description: Lower bound of the allowed port range (inclusive).

options.name: registry_path
options.description: Path to the JSON registry file that stores port mappings.

options.name: rotate_days
options.description: If the registry file is older than this many days and all referenced ports are currently free, the registry is wiped (rotated).

options.name: state
options.description: C(present) allocates or marks a mapping as used. C(query) returns the current mapping for the given hash. C(release) marks the mapping as unused.
